title: Amazon.nl: fashion return with free return shipping
facts_text: I bought a cotton dress from Amazon.nl 15 days ago. The dress is unused and in perfect condition, with all tags attached, and it is eligible for free return shipping under the fashion return policy. I changed my mind about the colour and would like to return it.
request: Please accept the return and refund EUR 54.99 using the free fashion return label.
